// about me

Hey there! My name is Lukáš and I'd like to introduce you to my website. I'm a high school student from Slovakia, based in Košice.

I'm interested in physics, mathematics, and technology. In my free time, I enjoy almost any sport — but I'm most passionate about long‑distance running.

I'm always keen on meeting new people and starting new projects. I'd be delighted to collaborate and see what we can achieve together!

Problem Solving Team Player Proactive Mindset Tech Enthusiast
Physics & Maths
Curious about how things around me work — from the laws of motion to the elegance of equations.
Kind & Caring
I genuinely care about the people around me — always there to listen and support.
Long‑distance Running
An active form of rest that keeps me moving forward — one kilometre at a time.

Welcome to my new website

✍️ Lukáš 📅 1. 9. 2026
